description: On the tabletop in front of you, there’s a gold book box standing at the back right corner and a couple of small paperback books near the front. The left hand stays hovering near the center of the table while the right hand picks up the red paperback, turns it upright, and slides it into the open side of the gold box, then grabs the gray-blue paperback and inserts it beside the red one before letting go and pulling away.
